source: three REAL_ROOT brains registered internally (task0045-seed-proof.py), brains A and C reading the SAME folder. Mouse and key events are dispatched through the browser input pipeline (CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent / Input.dispatchKeyEvent); the save of edit 1 is a key sent through the operating system when the window could be brought forward. Every logical value is read back from the catalogue (map_brains, map_brain_resume_state) and from the real screen; the product's own IPC calls are read from the wire (CDP Network). One REAL close of the process.

tree.brainsSharingOneFolder: A and C (same sourceRef, same sourceLabel, different brainId)

edit1.how: brain A, the form walked with Tab and saved with Enter; name and icon typed with real key events
edit1.saveKeyPath: operating-system key (WScript.Shell SendKeys, window brought forward)
edit1.colourSetThrough: the page's value setter plus the real input event (a native colour picker cannot be driven)

edit2.how: brain B, mouse and typed text, saved with the Enregistrer button

checkedAfterEveryEdit: the other brains: the whole catalogue record, bit for bit (including the brain that shares the source)
the edited brain: brainId, sourceKind, sourceRef, sourceLabel and position unchanged
the source: name, size, date and SHA-256 of every file and directory under both roots
the Index and the journal: revision, node count and journal total of every brain
the resume record of every brain, and the active brain
the product's own IPC calls: exactly one map_brain_update, no map_open / map_view / map_refresh / map_rebuild / resume write / journal call
limits: No personal brain: the analysed trees were generated by task0045-seed-proof.py and die with the proof root

The native colour picker is an operating-system dialog that neither the page nor CDP can drive: the colour is set through the page's value setter and the real input event; name and icon are typed with real key events
Mouse and key events are dispatched through the browser input pipeline by the harness (CDP); only the edit-1 save may be an operating-system key, as edit1.saveKeyPath states
The close is a normal one (the window is asked to close); no claim about a crash of the process
F-036 / WCAG 2.2 AA is not claimed: this proves the form works with the keyboard and that the name and the icon stay visible with the colour, nothing more
F-035 FR/EN is not started; P-19 stays partial
Development workstation, local NTFS disk; not a modest-laptop acceptance test
